card.name: Dose before adjustment in interactions
card.fires_on: The word "dose" (or its first piece) in drug-interaction text, right before words like adjustment, reduction or monitoring. Also fires on a few nearby spots such as "concentration" before monitoring.

modes.label: Dose before adjustment
modes.description: The word dose appears in an interaction statement just ahead of adjustment or reduction.
